Leads
● Lead generation

Lead generationthat brings in qualified leadsin India.

Paid media, landing pages and follow-up funnels, connected to your CRM and Meta's Conversions API, so campaigns are judged on the leads your sales team accepts, not on form fills.

See the brands

In short

Lead generation is the work of bringing in enquiries from people who are likely to buy, then passing sales or admissions the ones worth a conversation.

Monday Marketing Company (MMC) runs it for B2B companies, educational institutes and D2C brands with considered purchases.

  • Connect every leadEvery lead goes to a CRM, and its stage is sent back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI).
  • Learn from qualified leadsCampaigns learn from the qualified leads, not only from form fills.
  • Judge by qualityThe work is judged by the cost of a qualified lead.
Where lead generation goes wrong

Five mistakes that fill the funnel with the wrong leads.

Most lead generation is measured on volume. Each stage below is where quality is lost, and the part of our service that protects it.

  1. 1
    Stage 1 of 5Define a qualified lead

    Marketing counts every form fill as a lead.

    If marketing and sales never agree what a good lead is, campaigns get judged on volume, sales complains about quality, and nobody can tell which is right.

    What we do

    We start by agreeing with your sales or admissions team what a qualified lead is, and the stages a lead passes through. That definition drives targeting, tracking and reporting.

    Lead generation strategy
  2. 2
    Stage 2 of 5Attract the right people

    Broad targeting, so the ads reach anyone who might click.

    Cheap clicks from the wrong audience become expensive leads that never buy or enrol. Intent matters more than reach.

    What we do

    We aim search and paid social at the queries and audiences that signal a real need, and build the SEO that keeps you found between campaigns.

    Search and paid media
  3. 3
    Stage 3 of 5Capture without friction

    A long form on a slow page, with no clear next step.

    Many enquiries start on a phone. Every extra field and every second of load time loses a lead who was already interested.

    What we do

    We build fast, mobile-first landing pages and short forms with one clear next step, such as a call, a demo or a WhatsApp message, and test them.

    Landing pages and conversion
  4. 4
    Stage 4 of 5Qualify with CRM and Meta CAPI

    Optimising campaigns on form fills.

    Ad platforms learn from what you tell them. Told only that a form was filled, Meta finds whoever fills forms cheapest, and lead quality can fall as volume rises.

    What we do

    We connect your leads to a CRM and send the stages that matter (qualified, meeting booked, applied, won, enrolled) back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI), so campaigns learn what a good lead looks like.

    CRM and Conversions API
  5. 5
    Stage 5 of 5Follow up and nurture

    Leads wait days for a reply, then go cold.

    Many leads are not ready at first contact. The business that replies quickly and keeps sensible contact is the one remembered when the decision is made.

    What we do

    We build retention funnels of WhatsApp, email and call reminders, triggered from the CRM, that keep each lead warm until they are ready and win back the quiet ones.

    Retention marketing

Lead quality

How CRM and Meta CAPI make leads better.

A form fill tells Meta that someone showed interest, not that they were a good lead. Your CRM knows what happened next. The Conversions API (CAPI) carries that back to Meta.

  1. Step 1The lead arrivesAn ad brings a form fill, a call or a WhatsApp message.A lead
  2. Step 2Your CRM records what happensYour team marks it qualified, meeting booked, applied, won or enrolled.Qualified · Meeting · Won
  3. Step 3CAPI sends the stage to MetaThe stage goes back to Meta as a server-side event, not a browser guess.Server-side event
  4. Step 4Meta learns your best leadsThe platform can move away from cheap form fills and find more people like the ones your team accepted.A clearer signal
Back to step 1The next ads find more leads like the good ones
Without the CRM feedback

Optimised for form fills

  • The platform sees only that a form was submitted. It finds whoever fills forms cheapest, and your team spends the week on leads that never fit.
With CRM and CAPI

Optimised for qualified leads

  • The platform sees which leads your team accepted and which became customers. Spend can move toward that kind of buyer, and the cost of a qualified lead becomes the number to watch.

Common questions

What people ask about lead generation first.

What is lead generation?

It is the work of bringing in enquiries from people likely to buy, then passing your sales or admissions team the ones worth a conversation. The measure that matters is the cost of a qualified lead, not the number of form fills.

How do CRM and Meta CAPI improve lead quality?

A form fill only tells Meta that someone showed interest. When your leads sit in a CRM, we send what happened next (qualified, meeting booked, applied, won, enrolled) back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI). Meta can then learn which leads your team actually wants and look for more of them, instead of optimising for the cheapest form fill.

What counts as a qualified lead?

That is for your sales or admissions team to define, and we agree it with them at the start. It might be a lead that answers the phone and fits your criteria, a booked meeting, or a completed application.

Which CRM do we need?

Any CRM that records lead stages and can pass them on. If you do not have one, we can help you choose one.

Who is lead generation for?

B2B companies, educational institutes and D2C brands with considered purchases. See the B2B, education and D2C pages for how it differs.

What does it cost?

It depends on scope and, for media, on ad spend, so we quote after the audit call, once we have seen your accounts.
